text:
Elaine Harper: Heads-up — billing + quota update for Hosted API customers. Effective 2024-06-15 UTC we are changing per-account rate limits and overage handling. Details below and link to the internal spec: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/quota-update :loudspeaker:

Elaine Harper: TL;DR:
- New default rate limits: 60 req/min (short requests) and 1,000 tokens/min per account for free tier.
- Pay-as-you-go customers can request higher limits via Support.
- Overage policy: instead of immediate hard blocks, requests that exceed quota will receive 429s for 24h, then be throttled to a reduced rate; charges for overage are itemized on the next monthly invoice.
- Free credits: trial free credit amounts reduced from $50 -> $25 for new signups starting the same date. Existing credits are unaffected.
- Dedicated & Private deployments are not affected by these hosted default limits.

Ryan Chen: Quick clarifying q — does this apply to Dedicated tenants that use our hosted control plane for billing?

Finance Team: Short answer: No change to committed capacity contracts. If a customer is on a Reserved/Dedicated plan, their SLA & commit terms still govern. The hosted PAYG plan and free-tier accounts are the ones impacted.

Devon (DevEx): For SDKs: what will the 429 look like? Any new headers or retry guidance we should bake into clients?

Billing Bot: Automatically generated snippet: new headers added to responses when quota is close/exceeded:
- `X-RW-Quota-Remaining: <tokens>`
- `X-RW-RateLimit-Reset: <unix_ts>`
- `X-RW-Overage-Estimated: <cents>`

Billing Bot: Suggested retry semantics:
```
// pseudo-code for exponential backoff + respect to X-RW-RateLimit-Reset
if (response.status == 429) {
  if (response.headers['X-RW-RateLimit-Reset']) {
    waitUntil = parseInt(response.headers['X-RW-RateLimit-Reset']) * 1000
    sleep(max(1000, waitUntil - Date.now()))
  } else {
    sleep(exponentialBackoff())
  }
  retry()
}
```

Maria Gonzalez: We need a comms plan for customers — will there be an in-console banner + email + changelog? Also what's the script for sales to explain why free credits were reduced?

Elaine Harper: Yes: in-console banner one week before, targeted email 10 days before, and a detailed changelog entry. I'll loop in Marketing & Sales; we'll provide recommended wording for customer-facing teams. For sales: emphasize that we reduced trial credits to keep abuse minimal while rolling out more onboarding credits for verified teams.

Finance Team: Invoicing specifics: overages will be accrued in the billing dashboard in real time and added to the monthly invoice. Customers will see a line item called "Hosted API overage (month)". For customers who hit > $5k in estimated overage before invoice, Finance will send outreach and offer short-term limits increase options.

Devon (DevEx): Will this require any server-side SDK updates or just docs? I can push a patch to the JS/py SDKs to respect the new headers if needed.

Billing Bot: We're going to add the header support to the SDKs in the next minor release. Devon, please coordinate and include sample handling as above.

Elaine Harper: Action items:
- @Devon publish SDK snippet + update retry docs (due 2024-05-30)
- @Finance prepare invoice language + outreach list (due 2024-05-20)
- @Marketing + @Sales prepare comms + banner copy (due 2024-05-08)

Elaine Harper: I'll post a final customer-facing changelog on 2024-05-08. If you spot anything suspicious in the spec, @reply here. Thanks all :pray:
